note: The repository once carried 29 of these. Phase 1 replaced every value with the constant that defines it, so the expected set is empty. A non-empty run means either a new statement spelled a value out, or a constant moved and something still names the old one.

plantingRounds.plantedBy: an agent held apart from the implementation, with the check's source, its suite and the plan documents out of reach
whatItFound: Only three sections were being read, so a stale value in an evidence Reference or a Related Docs row went unreported. Both are pure pointers.
An end marker was compared by whole string, so a marker that opened correctly and closed wrongly was invisible: two of the six kinds were effectively unprotected.

plantingRounds.plantedBy: the same agent, same restrictions, boundaries of its own choosing
plantingRounds.note: Seven of the eighteen were the round-one misses, replanted in sections that are read; all seven were reported. Of the four new misses, three are values that are not the constant at all — full-width digits, a filename split by emphasis, a literal broken across lines — and catching them would mean loosening the comparison at the cost of false positives on near variants. The agent reported that the harness pushed part of the suite into its context after the planting was finished; it was not used for the judgement.
whatItFound: A heading with a non-breaking space in it renders exactly like the ordinary one, reads correctly to anyone looking at it, and carried a version the tool had left behind. Pasting from a rendered document is how that character arrives.
A Related Docs finding was reported at the block heading rather than at the row, thirteen lines above the text it was about.
